query_profile.quantity_meaning: observer-centered apparent IAU76/80 Earth ecliptic-of-date longitude and latitude with light-time, gravitational deflection, and stellar aberration
query_profile.ut_comparison: same source-table UT labels, allowing each implementation to use its own TDB/TT-minus-UT model
query_profile.tt_comparison: same TT Julian instants derived from the locked Swiss profile, isolating ephemeris and reference-frame differences from Delta-T

why_barycenters_are_used: Horizons documents objects 0-10, 199, 299, 301, and 399 as available over the required ancient interval. Planet-center targets 499, 599, and 699 do not cover these BCE dates, so outer-planet comparisons use system barycenters and retain that limitation explicitly.
findings: At identical ancient UT labels, the largest longitude difference is lunar and is consistent with the different Delta-T models.
Horizons TDB-UT exceeds the locked Swiss value by approximately 95 to 225 seconds across the eleven instants.

At identical TT instants, all 67 longitudes agree within 0.000823 degrees; the nearly common longitude offset is consistent with differing ecliptic-of-date/reference-frame realizations and is not silently subtracted.

This independent comparison supports the modern tropical longitudes used in the Rochberg reproduction but does not validate Rochberg's ancient-zodiac correction values, tablet readings, calendar conversions, or judgments.
limits: Horizons is a live service whose models and API version can change; any drift-gate failure requires review rather than automatic fixture replacement.
The TT list uses the locked Swiss Delta-T model only to define common dynamical instants; the Horizons UT comparison separately exposes model disagreement.
IAU76/80 Horizons ecliptic-of-date and Swiss Ephemeris ecliptic-of-date are not assumed identical.
Outer-planet barycenter-versus-center differences remain part of the error budget.
The observed gates were selected after this research run and are not preregistered production acceptance criteria.
Final golden vectors require an immutable Horizons response snapshot or offline JPL SPK pipeline, source review, and prospective tolerances.
